text: Rafi was in the wheelchair. Bea said, “I want to hang the paper flags.” Rafi told Bea, “I want to tie the silver moon flag.” Bea borrowed the green string. Bea tied the green string across the entrance. The bread cart was blocked. Rafi said, “I need space.” She untied the green string. Bea carried the green string to the welcome fence. She steadied the green string. Rafi tied the green string. He tied the silver moon flag on the green string. Bea hung the paper flags beside the silver moon flag. Mr Duran pushed the bread cart through the entrance. The silver moon flag shone.
